token.runelegend.soul_siphon.description: A %s chance on a hostile kill to add %s maximum HP without stacking
token.runelegend.echo.description: A %1$s chance on a hostile kill to leave a %2$s-block zone. It deals %3$s HP to hostiles every %5$s seconds for %4$s seconds
token.runelegend.immediate_counter.descr: Guard a hit to add %s HP to direct melee hits for %s seconds, then cool down for %s seconds after the effect ends
token.runelegend.venomous_tip.descriptio: Melee attacks have a %1$s chance to inflict Poison Ⅱ for %2$s seconds
token.runelegend.substitute.description: At %1$s health or less, summon a full-health substitute with your maximum health and armor. Monsters prioritize substitutes within targeting range. It dies automatically after %2$s seconds and starts a %3$s-second cooldown
token.runelegend.poisoned_arrow.descript: Arrow hits have a %1$s chance to inflict Poison Ⅱ for %2$s seconds
token.runelegend.fountain_of_life.descri: At %1$s health or less, create a fountain at your feet with a %2$s-block radius for %3$s seconds. Living players inside receive Regeneration %4$s and Resistance %5$s. On leaving or when the fountain expires, the effects linger for %6$s and %7$s seconds respectively. When the fountain expires, it starts a %8$s-second cooldown.
token.runelegend.full_blessing.descripti: At %1$s health or less, bless all living players %2$s times immediately. Each blessing heals %3$s HP at or below that threshold. Above it, players can store up to %4$s blessings that automatically heal them when they reach the threshold. Cooldown: %5$s seconds.
token.runelegend.retribution.description: Taking damage from an active attack triggers this token for %1$s seconds. Starting with that hit, accumulate damage taken before absorption. Each direct melee hit on a non-player creature adds that total as true damage. The total resets when the effect ends, then the token cools down for %2$s seconds.
token.runelegend.asura_form.description: Kill %1$s monsters to transform for %2$s seconds: melee hits add %3$s HP of true damage, you move as if you had Speed %4$s, and you use a temporary %5$s HP health bar. When the form ends, your original health returns and a %6$s-second cooldown begins.
token.runelegend.vernal_tide.description: While you have Regeneration, melee attacks have a %1$s chance to deal %3$s HP of true damage to the target and to other enemies within %2$s blocks of you
token.runelegend.execution_echo.descript: After a melee kill of a hostile target, record that attack's damage after all token bonuses are added (rounded up, capped at %4$s HP). Each melee hit then adds the recorded amount as true damage. It decreases by %1$s HP every %2$s seconds and ends at 0, then cools down for %3$s seconds.
token.runelegend.resonance_healing.descr: When at or below %1$s health, a successful block heals each eligible player within %2$s blocks of you for %3$s HP per living enemy within the same radius. Cooldown: %4$s seconds
token.runelegend.arrogance.description: While above %1$s health, the first enemy kill adds %3$s HP of true damage to direct melee hits. Every %2$s enemy kills thereafter increases the bonus by %3$s HP, up to %4$s HP. Progress resets at or below the threshold. No cooldown.
